title: TR-MTEB: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Embedding Model Suite for Turkish Sentence Representations
subcategory: language-specific MTEB benchmark + monolingual embedding models
task: Benchmarking Turkish sentence embeddings across six task types
problem: Turkish is barely covered by multilingual MTEB, so Turkish embedding models cannot be evaluated or developed reliably.
architecture: TR-MTEB with 26 native and translated datasets (classification, clustering, pair classification, retrieval, bitext mining, STS; translated retrieval sets checked by an LLM evaluator); 34.2M weakly supervised Turkish pairs; bert-base-turkish-uncased trained with cached MNRL contrastive loss then supervised fine-tuning.
llm_or_encoder: BERT-base Turkish encoder; LLM only as translation quality evaluator

datasets.name: Turkish sentence pairs (weakly supervised)
datasets.details: 34.2 million pairs from over 50 public datasets

metrics: MTEB task metrics: accuracy, V-measure, AP, nDCG@10, F1, Spearman
key_results: multilingual-e5-large leads with Mean(Task) 66.82; the fine-tuned Turkish model reaches 63.42 (up from 59.84 for the contrastive-only model and 49.54 for bert-base-turkish-uncased).
Monolingual models trail on bitext mining (37.7 and 86.88) vs LaBSE 99.53.
strengths: Public benchmark, data and models for a morphologically rich, under-served language.
Includes static-vector baselines to quantify the contextual gap.

limitations.text: Monolingual models lack cross-lingual pairs and underperform on bitext mining.
Part of the benchmark is translated, which may not capture native phenomena.

notes: LLM evaluator for translation reached 85.2% agreement with humans.
